# HR Admin Payroll and Benefits Review

This document details key action items for the HR & Admin department:

## Annual Leave Management
*   Investigate the annual leave urgently.
*   Update the annual leave quarterly.

## Medical Insurance
*   Review the medical insurance standard update.
*   Monitor the medical insurance urgently.

## Career Development
*   Review the career development quarterly.
